product_metadata.title: Misby Coffee Warmer for Desk Cup Warmer with Automatic Shut Off Coffee Mug Warmer for Coffee Milk Tea Keep (Green)
features: Special Features：Fashion Upgrade coffee mug warmer

Maintain optimal temperature: This Coffee mug warmer not only can slow down the cooling speed of hot coffee, But also can heat your coffee up to 120℉-140℉(40-60℃), and keep this temperature whole day，which is neither too hot nor too cold, you can sip your coffee at any time, without waiting.

Reliable and Durable: With high-tech materials make the coffee warmer heat-resistant and fire-resistant. The spill-proof design avoids damage and makes cleaning a breeze.Flat mug bottom makes full contact with the warming plate to keep your coffee warm

Easy to use: Thanks to the microgravity technology, this mug warmer can shut off/on auto. Just plug the adapter into outlet, then put your mug on and the cup warmer will work auto, take it away, the cup warmer will off auto.NOTE: It does not support to boil liquids.

Perfect Match: The electric coffee cup warmer has 3.5" diameter heating area. It can be fit most cups, such glass cup,stainless steel cup, Ceramic cup etc. for better results, we recommend using flat bottom glass cup or stainless steel cup. Placing a lid over the mug will also help retain heat.

Winter's Gift: This coffee warmer plate is a great choice for keeps your body warm all day, great helper to creat a better life. And also Popular for Birthday,Christmas,Thanksgiving Days Gift. Pass your love and concern to your family members and friends.
